answer_page.gloss_en: To stop sleeping; to awake.
answer_page.example_en: I wake up at seven every day.
answer_page.example_zh: 我每天七点醒来。

examples.example_en: I wake up at seven every day.
examples.example_zh: 我每天七点醒来。

answer_page.usage_note: 不及物 wake up 表示醒来；wake somebody up 表示叫醒别人。

answer_page.gloss_en: To rise from one's bed, usually upon waking up in order to begin one's day.
answer_page.example_en: I get up after my alarm rings.
answer_page.example_zh: 闹钟响后我就起床。

examples.example_en: I get up after my alarm rings.
examples.example_zh: 闹钟响后我就起床。

answer_page.usage_note: get up 表示从床上起来，不一定与 wake up 同时发生。

answer_page.gloss_en: To rise from bed after sleeping.
answer_page.example_en: I got out of bed when the alarm rang.
answer_page.example_zh: 闹钟响后我就从床上起来了。

examples.example_en: I got out of bed when the alarm rang.
examples.example_zh: 闹钟响后我就从床上起来了。

answer_page.usage_note: 强调离开床铺这一动作；与 wake up（醒来）不同。

answer_page.gloss_en: To not sleep, to stay awake. (This entry is a translation hub.)
answer_page.example_en: I am still awake at midnight.
answer_page.example_zh: 午夜时我还醒着。

examples.example_en: I am still awake at midnight.
examples.example_zh: 午夜时我还醒着。

answer_page.usage_note: be awake 描述醒着的状态。

answer_page.gloss_en: To have already risen from bed.
answer_page.example_en: Are you up yet, or are you still sleeping?
answer_page.example_zh: 你已经起床了吗，还是仍在睡觉？

examples.example_en: Are you up yet, or are you still sleeping?
examples.example_zh: 你已经起床了吗，还是仍在睡觉？

answer_page.usage_note: be up 在早晨语境中常表示已经起床；具体意义取决于上下文。

answer_page.gloss_en: To pass from a state of wakefulness into sleep.
answer_page.example_en: I fell asleep during the movie.
answer_page.example_zh: 我看电影时睡着了。

examples.example_en: I fell asleep during the movie.
examples.example_zh: 我看电影时睡着了。

answer_page.usage_note: fall asleep 表示由清醒进入睡眠的变化。

answer_page.gloss_en: To fall asleep again after waking.
answer_page.example_en: I woke up at five but went back to sleep.
answer_page.example_zh: 我五点醒了，但又睡了过去。

examples.example_en: I woke up at five but went back to sleep.
examples.example_zh: 我五点醒了，但又睡了过去。

answer_page.usage_note: go back to sleep 强调醒后再次入睡。

answer_page.gloss_en: To fall asleep slowly.
answer_page.example_en: She drifted off on the sofa.
answer_page.example_zh: 她在沙发上渐渐睡着了。

examples.example_en: She drifted off on the sofa.
examples.example_zh: 她在沙发上渐渐睡着了。

answer_page.usage_note: drift off 强调慢慢入睡，也有走神的其他义项。

answer_page.gloss_en: To fall asleep unintentionally.
answer_page.example_en: He dozed off on the train.
answer_page.example_zh: 他在火车上不知不觉打起了瞌睡。

examples.example_en: He dozed off on the train.
examples.example_zh: 他在火车上不知不觉打起了瞌睡。

answer_page.usage_note: doze off 通常强调短暂、不经意地睡着。

answer_page.gloss_en: To sleep late; to go on sleeping past one's customary or planned hour.
answer_page.example_en: I like to sleep in on Sundays.
answer_page.example_zh: 星期天我喜欢睡懒觉。

examples.example_en: I like to sleep in on Sundays.
examples.example_zh: 星期天我喜欢睡懒觉。

answer_page.usage_note: sleep in 表示比惯常起床时间晚些起床。

answer_page.gloss_en: To stay in bed (longer than usual).
answer_page.example_en: We had a lie-in on Saturday.
answer_page.example_zh: 星期六我们睡了个懒觉。

examples.example_en: We had a lie-in on Saturday.
examples.example_zh: 星期六我们睡了个懒觉。

answer_page.usage_note: lie in 在此是英式用法；与分娩相关的旧义不同。

answer_page.gloss_en: To sleep for longer than intended.
answer_page.example_en: I overslept and missed the bus.
answer_page.example_zh: 我睡过了头，错过了公交车。

examples.example_en: I overslept and missed the bus.
examples.example_zh: 我睡过了头，错过了公交车。

answer_page.usage_note: oversleep 指睡得比原计划久。

answer_page.gloss_en: To sleep, especially briefly; to nap, doze.
answer_page.example_en: I snoozed for ten more minutes.
answer_page.example_zh: 我又小睡了十分钟。

examples.example_en: I snoozed for ten more minutes.
examples.example_zh: 我又小睡了十分钟。

answer_page.usage_note: snooze 可作动词，表示短暂打盹；不要与闹钟延后按钮义混淆。

answer_page.gloss_en: To remain in bed instead of getting out.
answer_page.example_en: I stayed in bed for another ten minutes.
answer_page.example_zh: 我又在床上待了十分钟。

examples.example_en: I stayed in bed for another ten minutes.
examples.example_zh: 我又在床上待了十分钟。

answer_page.usage_note: stay in bed 不一定表示正在睡觉。

answer_page.gloss_en: To remain conscious while lying in bed.
answer_page.example_en: I lay awake thinking about tomorrow's meeting.
answer_page.example_zh: 我醒着躺在床上，想着明天的会议。

examples.example_en: I lay awake thinking about tomorrow's meeting.
examples.example_zh: 我醒着躺在床上，想着明天的会议。

answer_page.usage_note: lie 的过去式为 lay；lie awake 不表示睡着。

answer_page.gloss_en: To be unable to settle into a comfortable sleeping position.
answer_page.example_en: I tossed and turned all night.
answer_page.example_zh: 我整夜辗转反侧。

examples.example_en: I tossed and turned all night.
examples.example_zh: 我整夜辗转反侧。

answer_page.usage_note: toss and turn 常用于描述睡不安稳、不断翻身。

answer_page.gloss_en: To sleep continuously throughout the night.
answer_page.example_en: The baby finally slept through the night.
answer_page.example_zh: 宝宝终于整夜都睡得很安稳。

examples.example_en: The baby finally slept through the night.
examples.example_zh: 宝宝终于整夜都睡得很安稳。

answer_page.usage_note: sleep through the night 常用于描述夜间持续睡眠。

answer_page.gloss_en: To stop sleeping earlier than usual.
answer_page.example_en: I woke up early to catch the first train.
answer_page.example_zh: 为了赶首班火车，我早早醒来了。

examples.example_en: I woke up early to catch the first train.
examples.example_zh: 为了赶首班火车，我早早醒来了。

answer_page.usage_note: wake up 表示醒来，而不一定立即起床。

answer_page.gloss_en: To stop sleeping later than expected or usual.
answer_page.example_en: I woke up late and missed breakfast.
answer_page.example_zh: 我醒得太晚，错过了早餐。

examples.example_en: I woke up late and missed breakfast.
examples.example_zh: 我醒得太晚，错过了早餐。

answer_page.usage_note: wake up late 强调醒来的时间晚。

answer_page.gloss_en: Used other than figuratively or idiomatically: see get up, early.
answer_page.example_en: Next Tuesday we'll have to get up early, because the site visit starts at dawn.
answer_page.example_zh: 下周二我们得早起，因为实地考察在黎明时开始。

examples.example_en: Next Tuesday we'll have to get up early, because the site visit starts at dawn.
examples.example_zh: 下周二我们得早起，因为实地考察在黎明时开始。

answer_page.gloss_en: To leave bed later than usual.
answer_page.example_en: I got up late on Sunday.
answer_page.example_zh: 周日我起床很晚。

examples.example_en: I got up late on Sunday.
examples.example_zh: 周日我起床很晚。

answer_page.usage_note: get up late 强调起床晚，而不是仅仅醒得晚。

answer_page.gloss_en: A person who wakes easily from sleep.
answer_page.example_en: I'm a light sleeper, so even small noises wake me.
answer_page.example_zh: 我睡眠很浅，一点小声响都会吵醒我。

examples.example_en: I'm a light sleeper, so even small noises wake me.
examples.example_zh: 我睡眠很浅，一点小声响都会吵醒我。

answer_page.usage_note: light sleeper 指容易被声音或动静吵醒的人。

answer_page.gloss_en: A person who is not easily awakened.
answer_page.example_en: He's a heavy sleeper and rarely hears his alarm.
answer_page.example_zh: 他睡得很沉，几乎听不到闹钟。

examples.example_en: He's a heavy sleeper and rarely hears his alarm.
examples.example_zh: 他睡得很沉，几乎听不到闹钟。

answer_page.usage_note: heavy sleeper 的意思是睡得沉的人，不表示体重。

answer_page.gloss_en: To sleep for a sufficient amount of time.
answer_page.example_en: I need to get enough sleep before the exam.
answer_page.example_zh: 考试前我需要睡够觉。

examples.example_en: I need to get enough sleep before the exam.
examples.example_zh: 考试前我需要睡够觉。

answer_page.usage_note: enough 修饰 sleep；常用 get enough sleep。

answer_page.gloss_en: To have had less sleep than one needs.
answer_page.example_en: I'm short on sleep after working late.
answer_page.example_zh: 昨晚工作到很晚，我睡眠不足。

examples.example_en: I'm short on sleep after working late.
examples.example_zh: 昨晚工作到很晚，我睡眠不足。

answer_page.usage_note: be short on 表示某物不足；这里指睡眠时间不够。

answer_page.gloss_en: To get additional sleep after not sleeping enough.
answer_page.example_en: I'll catch up on sleep this weekend.
answer_page.example_zh: 这个周末我要补补觉。

examples.example_en: I'll catch up on sleep this weekend.
examples.example_zh: 这个周末我要补补觉。

answer_page.usage_note: catch up on sleep 常指在缺觉之后增加睡眠时间。

answer_page.gloss_en: To sleep well for a night.
answer_page.example_en: I hope you get a good night's sleep.
answer_page.example_zh: 希望你今晚睡个好觉。

examples.example_en: I hope you get a good night's sleep.
examples.example_zh: 希望你今晚睡个好觉。

answer_page.usage_note: night's 为所有格形式；常说 get a good night's sleep。

answer_page.gloss_en: A night during which one sleeps poorly.
answer_page.example_en: I had a restless night before the interview.
answer_page.example_zh: 面试前一晚我睡得不安稳。

examples.example_en: I had a restless night before the interview.
examples.example_zh: 面试前一晚我睡得不安稳。

answer_page.usage_note: restless night 强调夜里不安稳、难以安睡。

answer_page.gloss_en: A difficult night, often involving poor sleep.
answer_page.example_en: I had a rough night and feel exhausted.
answer_page.example_zh: 昨晚我过得不太好，现在累坏了。

examples.example_en: I had a rough night and feel exhausted.
examples.example_zh: 昨晚我过得不太好，现在累坏了。

answer_page.usage_note: rough night 也可能指其他艰难经历，并非只指睡眠。

answer_page.gloss_en: Having had sufficient (or even more than enough) sleep or rest to function optimally during waking hours.
answer_page.example_en: I feel well-rested today.
answer_page.example_zh: 今天我感觉休息得很充分。

examples.example_en: I feel well-rested today.
examples.example_zh: 今天我感觉休息得很充分。

answer_page.usage_note: well-rested 形容休息充足的状态。

answer_page.gloss_en: Being kept awake to the point of noticeably lower alertness through a lack of sleep; experiencing sleep deprivation.
answer_page.example_en: Sleep-deprived workers may struggle to focus.
answer_page.example_zh: 睡眠不足的工作人员可能难以集中注意力。

examples.example_en: Sleep-deprived workers may struggle to focus.
examples.example_zh: 睡眠不足的工作人员可能难以集中注意力。

answer_page.usage_note: sleep-deprived 指因缺乏睡眠而受到影响。

answer_page.gloss_en: Tired; feeling the need for sleep.
answer_page.example_en: I feel sleepy after lunch.
answer_page.example_zh: 午饭后我觉得困。

examples.example_en: I feel sleepy after lunch.
examples.example_zh: 午饭后我觉得困。

answer_page.usage_note: sleepy 在此表示想睡觉，而不是让人发困的事物。

answer_page.gloss_en: Showing signs of being asleep or very sleepy, as not demonstrating full energy or attention.
answer_page.example_en: She was half-asleep when the phone rang.
answer_page.example_zh: 电话响时她正半睡半醒。

examples.example_en: She was half-asleep when the phone rang.
examples.example_zh: 电话响时她正半睡半醒。

answer_page.usage_note: half-asleep 表示注意力不充分、近乎睡着。

answer_page.gloss_en: Awake and very alert; vigilant, watchful.
answer_page.example_en: After the nap I was wide awake.
answer_page.example_zh: 午睡后我完全清醒了。

examples.example_en: After the nap I was wide awake.
examples.example_zh: 午睡后我完全清醒了。

answer_page.usage_note: wide awake 强调非常清醒、警觉。

answer_page.gloss_en: A person who wakes up, without difficulty, early each morning and is alert and active during the first part of the day.
answer_page.example_en: My sister is a morning person.
answer_page.example_zh: 我姐姐习惯早起。

examples.example_en: My sister is a morning person.
examples.example_zh: 我姐姐习惯早起。

answer_page.usage_note: morning person 指早晨精力较好的人。

answer_page.gloss_en: One who goes to bed late, or stays up late at night or in the early hours of the morning.
answer_page.example_en: I am a night owl and work best late.
answer_page.example_zh: 我是夜猫子，深夜工作效率最高。

examples.example_en: I am a night owl and work best late.
examples.example_zh: 我是夜猫子，深夜工作效率最高。

answer_page.usage_note: night owl 在此指夜间活动或很晚入睡的人，不是鸟类本义。

answer_page.gloss_en: A pattern of sleeping and waking; especially a regular pattern of sleeping and waking designed to promote health.
answer_page.example_en: I am trying to keep a regular sleep schedule.
answer_page.example_zh: 我正努力保持规律的作息时间。

examples.example_en: I am trying to keep a regular sleep schedule.
examples.example_zh: 我正努力保持规律的作息时间。

answer_page.usage_note: sleep schedule 表示睡眠和醒来的时间安排。

answer_page.gloss_en: A biological clock.
answer_page.example_en: Jet lag can affect your body clock.
answer_page.example_zh: 时差反应可能影响你的生物钟。

examples.example_en: Jet lag can affect your body clock.
examples.example_zh: 时差反应可能影响你的生物钟。

answer_page.usage_note: body clock 指生物节律机制。

answer_page.gloss_en: A repeated pattern of sleep stages.
answer_page.example_en: My sleep cycle gets disrupted when I travel.
answer_page.example_zh: 旅行时我的睡眠周期容易被打乱。

examples.example_en: My sleep cycle gets disrupted when I travel.
examples.example_zh: 旅行时我的睡眠周期容易被打乱。

answer_page.usage_note: sleep cycle 指睡眠阶段的周期，不等同于固定作息时间。

answer_page.gloss_en: The hours of a day when a person is awake.
answer_page.example_en: I try to stay active during my waking hours.
answer_page.example_zh: 我尽量在清醒的时间保持活动。

examples.example_en: I try to stay active during my waking hours.
examples.example_zh: 我尽量在清醒的时间保持活动。

answer_page.usage_note: waking hours 指一天中醒着的时间。

answer_page.gloss_en: A device or signal used to wake someone or warn them.
answer_page.example_en: My alarm rings at six thirty.
answer_page.example_zh: 我的闹钟六点半响。

examples.example_en: My alarm rings at six thirty.
examples.example_zh: 我的闹钟六点半响。

answer_page.usage_note: alarm 在本场景指闹钟或提醒铃，不是泛指警报。

answer_page.gloss_en: A clock designed to sound an alert at a preset time, primarily to wake someone from sleep.
answer_page.example_en: My alarm clock rings at six.
answer_page.example_zh: 我的闹钟六点响。

examples.example_en: My alarm clock rings at six.
examples.example_zh: 我的闹钟六点响。

answer_page.usage_note: alarm clock 指设定时间发出提醒的钟。

answer_page.gloss_en: To program an alarm to sound at a chosen time.
answer_page.example_en: Don't forget to set an alarm for tomorrow.
answer_page.example_zh: 别忘了为明天设个闹钟。

examples.example_en: Don't forget to set an alarm for tomorrow.
examples.example_zh: 别忘了为明天设个闹钟。

answer_page.usage_note: 常用 set an alarm for + 时间。

answer_page.gloss_en: For an alarm to begin ringing or sounding.
answer_page.example_en: My alarm goes off at seven every morning.
answer_page.example_zh: 我的闹钟每天早上七点响。

examples.example_en: My alarm goes off at seven every morning.
examples.example_zh: 我的闹钟每天早上七点响。

answer_page.usage_note: go off 用于闹钟时表示响起，不表示关闭。

answer_page.gloss_en: To stop an alarm from sounding.
answer_page.example_en: I turned off the alarm and got up.
answer_page.example_zh: 我关掉闹钟，然后起床了。

examples.example_en: I turned off the alarm and got up.
examples.example_zh: 我关掉闹钟，然后起床了。

answer_page.usage_note: turn off 指停止闹铃，与 snooze（稍后再响）不同。

answer_page.gloss_en: A button on an alarm clock which, when pressed, silences the alarm temporarily, granting a few more minutes of sleep before the alarm sounds again.
answer_page.example_en: I pressed the snooze button twice.
answer_page.example_zh: 我按了两次贪睡键。

examples.example_en: I pressed the snooze button twice.
examples.example_zh: 我按了两次贪睡键。

answer_page.usage_note: snooze button 用于短暂推迟闹铃。

answer_page.gloss_en: To press the button that delays an alarm.
answer_page.example_en: I hit snooze twice before getting up.
answer_page.example_zh: 起床前我按了两次延迟提醒键。

examples.example_en: I hit snooze twice before getting up.
examples.example_zh: 起床前我按了两次延迟提醒键。

answer_page.usage_note: hit snooze 是口语表达，表示让闹钟稍后再响。

answer_page.gloss_en: To remain asleep despite an alarm sounding.
answer_page.example_en: I slept through the alarm and was late.
answer_page.example_zh: 闹钟响了我也没醒，结果迟到了。

examples.example_en: I slept through the alarm and was late.
examples.example_zh: 闹钟响了我也没醒，结果迟到了。

answer_page.usage_note: sleep through 强调某事发生时仍在睡觉。

answer_page.gloss_en: To fail to notice or respond to an alarm.
answer_page.example_en: I missed the alarm because my phone was on silent.
answer_page.example_zh: 手机调成了静音，我没听到闹铃。

examples.example_en: I missed the alarm because my phone was on silent.
examples.example_zh: 手机调成了静音，我没听到闹铃。

answer_page.usage_note: miss the alarm 在此指未注意到闹铃。

answer_page.gloss_en: An additional alarm used if the first one fails.
answer_page.example_en: I set a backup alarm in case I oversleep.
answer_page.example_zh: 我设了一个备用闹钟，以防睡过头。

examples.example_en: I set a backup alarm in case I oversleep.
examples.example_zh: 我设了一个备用闹钟，以防睡过头。

answer_page.usage_note: backup alarm 为备用提醒装置；backup 在这里作定语。

answer_page.gloss_en: To shake or move rapidly in small movements.
answer_page.example_en: My phone vibrates when the alarm goes off.
answer_page.example_zh: 闹钟响起时，我的手机会振动。

examples.example_en: My phone vibrates when the alarm goes off.
examples.example_zh: 闹钟响起时，我的手机会振动。

answer_page.usage_note: vibrate 本身意为振动，场景释义‘振动提醒’是具体用法。

answer_page.gloss_en: The sound a phone plays when it rings.
answer_page.example_en: I changed my ringtone so I could recognize my phone.
answer_page.example_zh: 我换了铃声，以便认出自己的手机在响。

examples.example_en: I changed my ringtone so I could recognize my phone.
examples.example_zh: 我换了铃声，以便认出自己的手机在响。

answer_page.usage_note: ringtone 通常指电话来电铃声，不专指闹钟铃声。

answer_page.gloss_en: A telephone call to awaken someone at a certain time, especially one requested by the person while staying at a hotel.
answer_page.example_en: Please arrange a wake-up call for seven.
answer_page.example_zh: 请安排七点的叫醒电话。

examples.example_en: Please arrange a wake-up call for seven.
examples.example_zh: 请安排七点的叫醒电话。

answer_page.usage_note: wake-up call 在此指叫醒服务，而非警醒事件的比喻义。

answer_page.gloss_en: The early part of the day, especially from midnight to noon.
answer_page.example_en: I go for a walk every morning.
answer_page.example_zh: 我每天早晨散步。

examples.example_en: I go for a walk every morning.
examples.example_zh: 我每天早晨散步。

answer_page.usage_note: morning 在此指一天较早的时段。

answer_page.gloss_en: The morning twilight period immediately before sunrise.
answer_page.example_en: We left home at dawn.
answer_page.example_zh: 我们黎明时离开了家。
